keyVerseDR: "I will not leave you orphans: I will come to you." (Jn 14:18)

level1.title: I Will Not Leave You
level1.story: Jesus said, "If you love Me, you will do what I ask." He promised to send the Holy Spirit. Jesus will never leave us alone.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who did Jesus promise to send?
How do you show love by obeying?
level1.prayer: Holy Spirit, help me love Jesus. Amen.

activity.title: I love Jesus by obeying
activity.intro: Color a heart each day you do what Jesus asks.

level2.title: The Promise of the Spirit
level2.story: At the Last Supper, Jesus said, "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments." He promised to ask the Father to send another Advocate, the Spirit of truth. "The world cannot see Him, but you know Him, because He remains with you," Jesus said. He promised, "I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you." Whoever loves Jesus will be loved by the Father.
level2.keyLine: I will not leave you orphans: I will come to you.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How are love and obedience connected?
How does the Holy Spirit help you?
level2.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, help me keep Your word. Amen.

activity.title: What does it mean?
activity.intro: Jesus says love means keeping His commandments. Explain in your own words.
